items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics NAV allows unauthenticated remote code execution. This critical flaw can lead to complete system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics NAV 不可信数据反序列化漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。此严重缺陷可能导致系统被完全破坏。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in .NET allows local code execution. It can be leveraged by attackers to escalate privileges on middleware servers.
items.reason_zh: .NET 反序列化漏洞允许本地代码执行。攻击者可利用该漏洞在中间件服务器上提升权限。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in .NET allows attackers to bypass security features over the network. This can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive middleware components.
items.reason_zh: .NET 授权不正确漏洞允许攻击者通过网络绕过安全功能。这可能导致未经授权访问敏感的中间件组件。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 SQL injection in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network, risking full database compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 SQL Server SQL 注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络提升权限，存在数据库被完全破坏和数据泄露的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the SQL Server ODBC driver allows unauthenticated network RCE. This critical flaw can be triggered by malicious database connections.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server ODBC 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行。此严重缺陷可通过恶意数据库连接触发。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server allows unauthorized spoofing over the network. This high-severity flaw can be used to steal credentials and hijack user sessions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 跨站脚本漏洞允许未经授权的网络欺骗。此高严重性缺陷可用于窃取凭据和劫持用户会话。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SQL Server allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. This can lead to unauthorized file access and further system compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 路径遍历漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络提升权限。这可能导致未经授权的文件访问和进一步的系统破坏。

items.reason_en: Adminer database management tool vulnerable to remote code execution via incorrect function return value check in multi_query, CVSS 7.2.
items.reason_zh: Adminer 数据库管理工具由于 multi_query 中函数返回值检查不正确而存在远程代码执行漏洞，CVSS 评分为 7.2。

items.reason_en: WildFly Elytron password hashing normalizes Unicode NFKC, collapsing fullwidth characters to ASCII and weakening password security, CVSS 7.4.
items.reason_zh: WildFly Elytron 密码哈希对 Unicode NFKC 进行规范化，将全角字符折叠为 ASCII 并削弱密码安全性，CVSS 评分为 7.4。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in ArcadeDB's Gremlin query engine allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting an insecure fallback to the Groovy engine.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB的Gremlin查询引擎中存在远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可通过利用不安全的Groovy引擎回退机制来执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Oracle Outside In Technology is vulnerable to remote code execution, allowing unauthenticated attackers with infrastructure logon to compromise the middleware.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Outside In Technology存在远程代码执行漏洞，允许拥有基础设施登录权限的未经身份验证的攻击者破坏该中间件。

items.reason_en: Oracle Hyperion Lifecycle Management can be compromised by unauthenticated network attackers, impacting enterprise performance management systems.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Lifecycle Management可被未经身份验证的网络攻击者破坏，从而影响企业绩效管理系统。

items.reason_en: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Manager vulnerability allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the application via HTTP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Manager漏洞允许低权限攻击者通过HTTP破坏该应用程序。

items.reason_en: Sequelize SQL injection via unescaped cast type in JSON/JSONB where clause processing allows attackers to manipulate database queries.
items.reason_zh: Sequelize在处理JSON/JSONB WHERE子句时，由于未转义的cast类型导致SQL注入漏洞，允许攻击者操纵数据库查询。

items.reason_en: Oracle Database RDBMS vulnerability allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to compromise the database via Oracle Net.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Database RDBMS漏洞允许低权限的已身份验证攻击者通过Oracle Net破坏数据库。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in IBM AIX and PowerVM VIOS allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8), critical for enterprises running IBM enterprise Unix systems.
items.reason_zh: IBM AIX和PowerVM VIOS中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），对运行IBM企业级Unix系统的企业至关重要。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in IBM AIX and PowerVM VIOS (CVSS 8.4) enables authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on these enterprise platforms.
items.reason_zh: IBM AIX和PowerVM VIOS中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞（CVSS 8.4），使已身份验证的远程攻击者能够在这些企业平台上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in IBM AIX and PowerVM VIOS allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8), affecting enterprise Unix and virtualization infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: IBM AIX和PowerVM VIOS中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），影响企业级Unix和虚拟化基础设施。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft HPC Pack allows remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8, affecting high-performance computing clusters.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft HPC Pack中存在不受信任的数据反序列化漏洞，允许远程代码执行（CVSS 9.8），影响高性能计算集群。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code allows remote code execution with a CVSS of 8.8, targeting a widely used development environment.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中存在授权缺失漏洞，允许远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），针对广泛使用的开发环境。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Microsoft Teams allows privilege escalation with a CVSS of 9.6, impacting enterprise communications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams中存在身份验证不当漏洞，允许权限提升（CVSS 9.6），影响企业通信。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in IBM AIX allows remote code execution with a CVSS of 9.8, representative of numerous critical vulnerabilities in AIX and PowerVM VIOS.
items.reason_zh: IBM AIX中存在整数溢出漏洞，允许远程代码执行（CVSS 9.8），代表了AIX和PowerVM VIOS中的众多严重漏洞。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution. It poses a severe risk to gaming infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。这对游戏基础设施构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows security feature bypass. It can be used to compromise developer environments and supply chains.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot和Visual Studio中存在注入漏洞，允许绕过安全功能。该漏洞可用于破坏开发者环境和供应链。

items.reason_en: Red Hat FreeIPA allows non-privileged users to trigger privileged Active Directory trust refresh via trust-fetch-domains command, CVSS 8.2.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat FreeIPA允许非特权用户通过trust-fetch-domains命令触发特权Active Directory信任刷新，CVSS 8.2。

items.reason_en: Wireshark X.509IF protocol dissector crash allows remote denial-of-service when processing crafted packets, CVSS 7.5.
items.reason_zh: Wireshark X.509IF协议解析器崩溃允许在处理特制数据包时导致远程拒绝服务，CVSS 7.5。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in FFmpeg's hvcC box writer can be triggered by crafted HEVC input files, leading to memory corruption and potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: FFmpeg的hvcC box写入器中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过特制的HEVC输入文件触发，导致内存损坏和潜在的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in GitPython allows attackers to inject malicious arguments into git read-tree, potentially compromising repository integrity.
items.reason_zh: GitPython中存在任意文件覆盖漏洞，允许攻击者将恶意参数注入git read-tree，从而可能破坏存储库完整性。

items.reason_en: gRPC-Go suffers from an authorization bypass due to improper validation of the HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header, allowing attackers to bypass routing and access controls.
items.reason_zh: gRPC-Go由于对HTTP/2 :path伪标头验证不当而存在授权绕过漏洞，允许攻击者绕过路由和访问控制。

items.reason_en: LMDeploy's disaggregated serving is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution via unsafe pickle deserialization of peer-to-peer messages.
items.reason_zh: LMDeploy的分离式服务存在任意代码执行漏洞，由于对点对点消息进行不安全的pickle反序列化所致。

items.reason_en: Netty's TLS handshake processing contains a flaw that can cause a denial of service when handling ClientHello messages spanning multiple records.
items.reason_zh: Netty的TLS握手处理存在缺陷，在处理跨越多个记录的ClientHello消息时可能导致拒绝服务。
